ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/references/fix-loop.md`. The skill requires this before every fix round. It sets who fixes round 5, how the re-review runs, and the adjudication rules after the fifth attempt.

ACTION: Dispatch a fix subagent for Task 6, round 5 of 5, on model `fable`. Round 4 was a thorough opus attempt at high effort and it still failed, and `fable` is in the Agent tool's model list. The prompt will contain:
- The path to the task brief made by `scripts/task-brief`. It will not include the whole plan file.
- Finding F1 word for word, plus the paths to the round-4 fix report and the re-review report. It will not contain a paste of the session history.
- An order to reproduce the race first with a test that starts the refresh thread and fails before the fix.
- The fact that the round-4 lock did not close the race at `cache/refresh.py:88`.
- An order to run the covering tests, show their output and commit.

Task 6 is not clean yet. The scoped re-review still reports F1: the invalidation races with the background refresh at `cache/refresh.py:88`. The round-4 test passes only because it never starts the refresh thread.

Round 4 was a full attempt on opus at high effort. The implementer had the right context and still failed. More effort will not help, so I am raising the model. I am dispatching round 5, the last one allowed, on `fable`.

After the fix, I will generate a new diff file and run a scoped re-review on opus. If F1 stays open, I will adjudicate as `fix-loop.md` says and bring the result to you. Tasks 1 to 5 stay complete in the ledger.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- A test that never starts the refresh thread cannot show that a lock fixes a race. It passes with or without the fix.
- A race test must fail before the fix. That failure proves the test can see the bug.
- Round 4 added a lock but did not cover the write at `cache/refresh.py:88`. A lock helps only when every reader and writer of the shared state takes it.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`
